name: Holice (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a yellow upper hoist part and a blue lower fly part, with a black diagonal stripe on the yellow and a white diagonal stripe on the blue along the division.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 9 April 2002 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
